title: Chapter 224: Limitation
html:
“Could Boss Chen’s parents have...” Song An’s throat felt packed with ice, and his lips trembled uncontrollably as he spoke.

“You saw that streak of blood beside the bed earlier. I kept quiet because we had outsiders with us.” Guo Miao took a cigarette from his pocket and placed it between his lips. “Fake blood isn’t that color. Those scratches and bloodstains probably came from a real person.”

“This scenario is full of similar scratches and bloodstains. If they’re all real...” Song An shuddered as he looked around. This isn’t a Haunted House; it’s a slaughterhouse!

“Boss, shall we call the cops?”

“I thought the same thing, but we’ve only been inside for ten minutes. If this is a misunderstanding, we’ll be humiliated for the rest of our lives.” Guo Miao bit down on the cigarette. “Let’s regroup with the others first.”

“Boss! Brother Song!” As the two spoke, Xiao Du ran toward them, gasping for breath. “The mannequins are alive! They’re following us, and no one is carrying them!”

“The mannequins are alive?” The bad news kept piling up.

“Yes. Mr. Han said workers were hiding among them, so he rushed into the group to drag them out.” Xiao Du’s breathing gradually steadied. He did feel safer beside Guo Miao and Song An.

“Did he find any workers?” Guo Miao and Song An’s expressions changed. This Haunted House held one nasty surprise after another.

“There was not one worker among the mannequins!”

“If no one moved them, why were they following us? Han Qiuming may be irritating, but he is a professional.”

“I don’t know. Even after destroying all the mannequins, Mr. Han found nothing unusual. They’re ordinary props.”

“Wait—Mr. Han destroyed them?” Guo Miao’s unease began to take shape.

“I warned him, but he tore off every one of their heads.” Xiao Du pursed his lips. “You should have seen him. He stood in the middle of all those broken mannequins and said that since Boss Chen had ruined Tian Teng Medical School, he would wreak havoc in Boss Chen’s Haunted House!”

Guo Miao and Song An froze. What the f*ck! Does that idiot have no sense of limits? Why would he provoke a deranged murderer?!

“What’s wrong with you two?” Xiao Du noticed their silence and the sudden weight in the air. “Are you scared too? I was at the back of the group, and it felt as though someone was following us. Every time I turned around, the mannequins had moved closer. I swear one of them even smiled at me!”

“Xiao Du, the mannequins aren’t our biggest concern.” Guo Miao had bitten his cigarette in half. He removed it and stuffed both pieces into his pocket.

“How can they not be? Boss, there are at least twenty of them. If they all come alive, how will we survive?” Xiao Du had expected a very different reaction from his boss.

“Boss is right. We have a larger problem to deal with.” Song An’s expression darkened. “First, we need to find Han Qiuming.”

Song An’s abrupt change in attitude confused Xiao Du. “Brother Song, didn’t you just argue with Mr. Han? You still want to look for him?”

“We don’t have a choice,” Song An said gravely. “I can’t simply let him die, can I?”

“Let him die?” Xiao Du’s mouth fell open. When did this become so serious? Aren’t we just visiting a Haunted House?

…

After Xiao Du and Su Luoluo left, Ye Xiaoxin remained where she was. Fearless and thoroughly enjoying the visit, she occasionally took out her notebook to jot down an observation.

“Were you waiting for me?” Han Qiuming’s heart leaped when he saw Ye Xiaoxin alone.

“I prefer to take my time and explore alone. Your friends went ahead.” Ye Xiaoxin pointed forward with her pen. The corner blocked their view of what had happened farther down the corridor.

Han Qiuming glanced at Ye Xiaoxin and found himself unable to look away. He quickened his pace to join her. “I can help with your review. I am a professional, after all. I’ve visited many Haunted Houses and worked with several foreign teams.”

“Is that so?” Ye Xiaoxin pushed open a random door and patiently examined everything inside.

“I’ve visited three Haunted Houses with mental-hospital themes alone. One was built inside an actual abandoned hospital. Now that was authentic.” When Han Qiuming saw Ye Xiaoxin trying to move the bed, he hurried in to help.

As he attempted to flirt, Guo Miao and Xiao Du called from around the corner. “Where is he? Qiuming! Han Qiuming!”

“He was just behind me earlier, where has he gone?”

“This place is too dangerous; we need to find him!”

“Han Qiuming!”

Footsteps raced through the corridor, but Han Qiuming pretended not to hear. He helped Ye Xiaoxin move the bed, then set it back in place.

“They’re calling you, aren’t you going to respond?”

“Why should I? They only come looking for me when they’re in trouble.” Han Qiuming chuckled. “There must be something frightening up ahead. Those men may look tough, but they’re useless. They all have to rely on me.”

Ye Xiaoxin offered no comment. “You can go with them if you want. I’d rather explore alone.”

“It’s fine. This way, we can watch each other’s backs.”

Unable to drive Han Qiuming away, Ye Xiaoxin said nothing more. She left the room and stepped into the corridor just after Guo Miao’s group had run past.

“Did you notice the numbers on the doors? Every room here begins with a two.” Han Qiuming did his best to show off, but Ye Xiaoxin showed no interest. They had walked only a short distance when she stopped.

“What’s wrong?”

“This door is different from the others.” Ye Xiaoxin pointed at its plaque. The lettering was smudged, but they could just make out the words ‘Director’s Office’.

“Maybe the recorder is inside. Come on, let’s take a look.”

…

Guo Miao and Song An ran the entire way, shouting until their throats were raw, but Han Qiuming never answered.

“This doesn’t make sense! He was right behind me!” Sweat covered Xiao Du’s brow as dreadful possibilities crowded his mind. “Do you think the mannequins abducted Mr. Han?”

“Probably not. If something had happened, he would have screamed, and we heard nothing.” Guo Miao frowned at the toppled mannequins and scattered heads, then gritted his teeth. “Don’t panic. He’s probably inside one of the sickrooms. We’ll retrace our steps and search.”
